facts.fact: Afrobarometer says Zambia repealed the offence of criminally defaming the president since 2021, citing National Assembly sources; the dispatch gives no repeal date, so its published date is used.

note: Survey results, the index rank, the access-to-information act and the February 2022 ruling that the Post closure was illegal give no fact in this study's values; undated mentions of harassment and detention of journalists name no one.
